prompt:
Hey — our e-commerce database is in really bad shape. The engineer who built it (Kim) just left the company, and they left behind some draft SQL files in `db/drafts/`. The analytics team keeps complaining about timeouts on the dashboard, support says customer lookups take forever, and our compliance team is asking about data isolation for customer records.

Can you review all the draft files Kim left and produce a single, final, production-ready SQL migration file named `schema_migration.sql`? It should fix all the performance problems and make sure customers can only see their own orders. The notes file Kim left should help explain what's broken.
